name: api
intro: Every route of the XTM One REST API: 1057 in 70 areas. The interface calls the same routes, so a script does what a person does on screen, with the rights of the user whose API key it sends: see [Script OpenAEV and XTM One with their REST APIs](/develop/apis/rest/). Your platform serves the same list with the fields of each route at `/api/reference`, and as an OpenAPI document at `/api/openapi.json`.
filter: Filter by path or by what a route does
